items.claim: Robocop is massive, super strong, and super explosive.
items.quote: Robocop is massive, he's super strong, he's super explosive.

items.claim: Fluffy Hernandez can take over the fight as the minutes tick by using his grappling and cardio.
items.quote: And as those as those minutes tick by, guys, I feel like you're going to see Fluffy take take this fight over.

items.claim: Robocop is not the type of guy to break necessarily, making the over likely.
items.quote: I don't think he's the type of guy to break necessarily. So, the over is pretty likely here in my eyes.

items.claim: Fluffy Hernandez has an ability to out-grapple people on the fence and relies on his cardio as a weapon.
items.quote: he does have an ability to out-grapple these people on the fence. And it's it's very technically sound, and he relies on his cardio, use that as a weapon

items.claim: Sergey Spivak gets it done with straight punches, kicking game, and grappling over Vitor Petrino.
items.quote: GIVE ME Sergey Spivak getting it done with his straight punches, with his kicking game, and maybe even his grappling over a heavily muscled Vitor Petrino.

items.claim: Reinier de Ridder is better at everything than Roman Dolidze and still has life in his career.
items.quote: I'M GOING TO TAKE REINIER de Ridder being better at everything than Roman Dolidze, and also just having some having some life in his career still.

items.claim: Roman Dolidze is on the outs.
Mason Jones has durability, toughness, and likes to get into a fight compared to Mark O. Madsen.
items.quote: give a slight lean to Mason Jones because he has durability. He has toughness. He likes to get into a fight.

items.claim: Mark O. Madsen wants to get into a sparring match.
items.quote: Mark O. Madsen wants to get into a sparring match.

items.claim: Leron Murphy should be twice as fast as Jamall Emmers and will defend takedowns.
items.quote: Leron Murphy should be twice as fast as Jamall Emmers and I believe he's defending these takedowns.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev has good striking at range, especially seen in his last two performances.
items.quote: I do like the striking at range with Shamil Gaziev, especially after seeing those last TWO PERFORMANCES.

items.claim: Alesha Zappitella has been finished in all of her UFC losses.
items.quote: Alesha Zappitella's been finished in all of her UFC losses.
